content:
## Is 3 Days Enough for Cappadocia?

Yes. Three days fit one sunrise balloon flight, the Red Tour and either the Green Tour or an activity day, with a spare morning to retry a weather-cancelled flight. This plan assumes you stay in Goreme, and every link goes to a real booking page.

## Day 1: Arrival and Settling In

Nevsehir Cappadocia airport is 30 km north-west of Nevsehir ([DHMI AIP](https://www.dhmi.gov.tr/AIPDocuments/LT_AD_2_LTAZ_en.pdf)); Kayseri airport is 5 km north of Kayseri ([DHMI AIP](https://www.dhmi.gov.tr/AIPDocuments/LT_AD_2_LTAU_en.pdf)). Private transfers to your hotel start from EUR35 from Nevsehir airport and from EUR55 from Kayseri airport.

Check in at one of the [cave hotels](/en/hotels) in Goreme, Urgup or Uchisar (price on request via WhatsApp). In the afternoon, walk the nearby valleys or join the [Sunset Panorama Tour](/en/tours/gun-batimi-turu), a 3-hour tour with wine at Aktepe and Kizilcukur Valley. Sunrise and sunset ATV, jeep or horse tours start from EUR30-35. Go to bed early: balloon pickup is before dawn.

## Day 2: Balloon Flight and Red Tour

Begin with a sunrise balloon flight. On [/en/balloon-tours](/en/balloon-tours) you can choose the Standard flight (from EUR100) or the Romantic private balloon for couples (on request). Pickup is early in the morning and the exact time is confirmed when you book.

After landing, rest at the hotel, then take the [Cappadocia Red Tour](/en/tours/kirmizi-tur) (from EUR50), a full-day cultural route covering Goreme Open-Air Museum, Uchisar Castle, Zelve Open-Air Museum, Pasabag, Devrent Valley, an Avanos pottery workshop and Love Valley. Goreme Archaeological Site, according to the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, [opened to visitors in 1967](https://muze.gov.tr/muze-detay?SectionId=GRM01&DistId=GRM), and the area is part of a [UNESCO World Heritage property](https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/357).

## Day 3: Green Tour or Activity Day, Then Departure

**Option A, nature and history:** the [Cappadocia Green Tour](/en/tours/yesil-tur) (from EUR50) is a full-day route through Derinkuyu Underground City, Ihlara Valley, Belisirma village and Selime Cathedral.

**Option B, an active day:** the [ATV Sunrise Tour](/en/activities/atv-sunrise) or the [Sunset Horseback Riding Tour](/en/activities/at-sunset), from EUR30-35, work well if your flight leaves in the afternoon or evening.

The Green Tour takes the whole day, so choose Option A only if you depart the next morning or later. If you retry a cancelled balloon flight on Day 3, pick Option B or leave the Green Tour out.

## Which Month Should You Pick?

April to June and September to October are the most comfortable months. Nevsehir's official 1981-2010 averages show daily highs of 16.3 C in April, 25.6 C in June and 19.1 C in October, while January lows average -3.5 C ([MGM](https://www.mgm.gov.tr/eng/forecast-cities.aspx?m=NEVSEHIR)). See [When to Visit Cappadocia?](/en/blog/kapadokya-ne-zaman-gidilir-en) for more.

## Balloon Flights and Weather

Balloon flights depend on weather, which is why this plan puts the flight on Day 2 and leaves Day 3 morning as a backup. Commercial balloon operations in Europe follow detailed rules such as [Commission Regulation (EU) 2018/395](https://www.easa.europa.eu/en/regulations/balloons-air-operations). If a flight is cancelled for weather, you get a 100% refund or a free date change. For customer-initiated cancellations, the refund is 100% at least 72 hours before, 50% from 24 to 72 hours, and none inside 24 hours. See [Is a Cappadocia Hot Air Balloon Ride Safe?](/en/blog/kapadokya-balon-turu-guvenli-mi-en).

## Budget Overview

Starting prices per person: Standard balloon flight from EUR100, Red Tour from EUR50, Green Tour from EUR50, ATV, jeep or horse tours from EUR30-35, Turkish night from EUR30, hamam from EUR50. Hotels and packages are priced on request. Message us on WhatsApp for a total that fits your dates.

## What to Pack

Dress in layers for the morning balloon flight; mornings are cool in any season. Wear closed, comfortable shoes (heels are a poor idea for climbing into the basket). In winter add a hat and gloves. Walking shoes and sun protection are enough for the tours.

## When to Book

Book the balloon flight and tours as early as you can, especially in April to June and September to October. [/en/balloon-tours](/en/balloon-tours), [/en/tours](/en/tours) and [/en/activities](/en/activities) show availability.

## Adjusting the Plan

Short on time? Do the balloon on the first morning if you arrive the evening before. Planning a honeymoon or proposal? Ask about the Romantic private balloon on WhatsApp. Whatever you choose, keep at least one free morning after the flight.

## Common Planning Mistakes

**Putting the balloon on your last morning.** A weather cancellation leaves you no second try. Book it with a day to spare.

**Squeezing the Red and Green Tours into one day.** Each is a full-day route; give them separate days.

**Forgetting the early pickup.** A late night makes the pre-dawn start harder.

**Overpacking Day 2.** A balloon flight plus a full-day tour is already a busy day; keep ATV or horse rides for another day.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is 3 days enough to see Cappadocia?
Yes, 3 days covers a balloon flight, the Red Tour and either the Green Tour or an activity day. With 4-5 days you can add more valley walks and slower mornings.

### Which day should I do the balloon flight?
Day 2 works well in this plan: you arrive rested and keep Day 3 morning as a backup if weather cancels the flight. Avoid the last morning of the trip.

### What is the difference between the Red Tour and the Green Tour?
The Red Tour covers northern Cappadocia cultural stops such as Goreme Open-Air Museum, Uchisar and Pasabag. The Green Tour heads south to Derinkuyu Underground City, Ihlara Valley and Selime Cathedral.

### Where should I stay in Cappadocia?
Goreme, Urgup and Uchisar are the most popular bases, and many visitors choose a cave hotel. See [/en/hotels](/en/hotels); hotel prices are on request via WhatsApp.

### Does a cancelled balloon flight wreck the plan?
No. A weather cancellation brings a 100% refund or a free date change, and with the flight on Day 2 you can move it to Day 3 morning.

### How much does a 3-day Cappadocia plan cost?
It depends on hotel, balloon type and tours. Activity prices start from EUR100 for the balloon, EUR50 for each tour and EUR30-35 for an ATV or horse ride. Message us on WhatsApp for an exact total.
